description: Make the worker OAuth-token env-strip host-only so host workers fall back to the config-dir login while container workers keep the injected token.

userStories.title: Strip CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN from host workers only
userStories.description: As the cam supervisor running in host mode, I need every spawned worker (implementer, reviewer, planner, auditor) to strip CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN via the `env -u` prefix so the worker authenticates with the interactive config-dir login (~/.claude-pessoal) instead of pinning to the possibly rate-limited token account, while container workers (which have no logged-in config dir) keep the token injected by worker-container.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: A new constant HOST_ONLY_ENV_UNSET = ['CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN'] exists in src/supervisor/worker-argv.ts, separate from WORKER_ENV_UNSET. [oracle: grep -q "HOST_ONLY_ENV_UNSET" src/supervisor/worker-argv.ts]

workerEnvPrefix() accepts an isolation argument (WorkerIsolation from src/config/models.ts); on 'host' the returned prefix includes '-u CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN' and on 'container' it does NOT. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/worker-argv.test.ts]

The isolation value is threaded through all three worker argv builders (buildImplementerWorkerArgv in worker-argv.ts wired from loop.ts:907, buildReviewerWorkerArgv in review.ts wired from review.ts:365, buildPlannerWorkerArgv + buildAuditorWorkerArgv in plan-argv.ts wired from plan-runner.ts:469/506) so the host-only strip applies to all four worker roles. [oracle: bun run typecheck]

On host isolation, each assembled worker command string contains '-u CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN' ahead of the 'claude' invocation. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/worker-argv.test.ts test/supervisor/review.test.ts test/supervisor/plan/plan-argv.test.ts]

On container isolation, the inner shell string wrapped by docker exec does NOT contain '-u CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN'. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/review.test.ts test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-container.test.ts]
worker-container.ts is unchanged: buildDockerRunArgv still threads the token name-only via '-e CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN'. [oracle: git diff --quiet HEAD -- src/supervisor/worker-container.ts]

The container parity tests assert host-only strip (host prefix diverges from the container inner string by exactly the '-u CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN' token) rather than requiring byte-for-byte equality of the env -u prefix. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-container.test.ts test/supervisor/review.test.ts]
CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and PATH remain unstripped on both host and container paths (existing invariant preserved). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/worker-argv.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Root cause (host mode): the tmux -L cam server is started by `cam run` with .env loaded, so CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN lives in the server process OS env and every respawn-pane worker inherits it, overriding the config-dir login. `tmux set-environment -g -u` cannot fix a live process; clearing .env only affects a fresh server. The durable fix is to strip the token at worker spawn via the `env -u ...` prefix, but ONLY on host. Files: src/supervisor/worker-argv.ts (add HOST_ONLY_ENV_UNSET; make workerEnvPrefix(isolation) isolation-aware; thread isolation into buildImplementerWorkerArgv), src/supervisor/review.ts (buildReviewerWorkerArgv threads isolation, caller at review.ts:365 already has workerIsolation at :347), src/supervisor/plan-argv.ts (buildPlannerWorkerArgv + buildAuditorWorkerArgv thread isolation, callers resolveAndSpawnPlanner/Auditor at plan-runner.ts:469/506 already receive workerIsolation), src/supervisor/loop.ts:907 (pass workerIsolation, available at :706). Import WorkerIsolation from src/config/models.ts. DO NOT touch worker-container.ts, the tmux server bootstrap, or the .env loading. GOTCHA: dockerExecWrap (loop.ts:1014, review.ts:406, plan-runner.ts:471/508) preserves the inner shell string byte-for-byte, so a naive addition to WORKER_ENV_UNSET would strip the token inside the container too and break the container worker (no logged-in config dir); this is why the strip must be isolation-gated at the builder. Make workerEnvPrefix's isolation arg required (not defaulted) so the compiler forces every call site to be explicit and no builder silently host-defaults inside a container. GOTCHA (CAM-55 lesson): argv-shape tests prove the command FORM only (host has the -u, container does not); they do NOT prove claude actually fell back to the config-dir login at runtime, which is operator-level manual validation. Tests to update: test/supervisor/worker-argv.test.ts, test/supervisor/review.test.ts (see :98-101 env-prefix assertions and :1509 container inner assertion), test/supervisor/plan/plan-argv.test.ts, test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-container.test.ts (AC5 host-vs-prior + host-vs-container inner). Consider a new insight bullet in scripts/cam/patterns.md about respawn-pane inheriting the tmux server OS env (not the set-environment table).
